hybridThrowerAudit.rule: When samong-r103.js spawn() borrows a donor through actor3(d,id,x,y,false,'DREAM',hostRegion), the actor's ai comes out 'hybrid' for every donor whose weapon profile is blade / heavy / caster / polearm, and 'melee' only for weapon 'claw' (plus the 5 native 'ranged' ids). Probe: 186 non-boss donors -> 160 hybrid, 21 melee, 5 ranged. 'hybrid' enemies call ranged3() -> enemyShot() -> makeShot(asset VFX.bolt) whenever clearLine(e,player): the light-blue bolt the owner saw. tickSurvival's swarm() (samong-r103.js:227) overwrites ai='melee', so survival is safe; tickMaze (:238) and the ascent guards (:239-240) do NOT, so melee-looking sprites throw bolts in the maze and on the climb.

mobRotationBug.bug: spawn() does ++S.serial once per spawn while the loop index n also rises by one, so (S.serial+n) keeps the same parity across a batch, and a 6-spawn batch leaves S.serial's parity unchanged: only ONE of the two mob rows ever appears in a run (observed test-aid: S-03 survival 56/56 dist04-c1, 0 skeleton; S-01 maze 18/18 a11-c1; S-04 only a10-o1; S-05 only b07-f1; S-06 only drones; RA only c106-e1).
mobRotationBug.fix: index by a spawn counter that does not advance with n, e.g. ep.mobs[(x.spawnCount++)%ep.mobs.length], or ep.mobs[n%ep.mobs.length] per batch. Spawn counts and caps are unchanged (same number of enemies), only the row choice.
